name: Video Remove Background 3.0
description: Bria's video background removal replaces the background of a clip up to 60 seconds long with a solid color or with transparency. Transparent output needs the mov_proresks (ProRes) preset. Frame rate and audio are preserved, and the output resolution matches the input unless auto_zoom crops to the subject.

examples.name: White Background
examples.description: Replace the background of a short 4K clip with white, using Bria's sample input and the default mp4_h264 preset. For a transparent result, set background_color to Transparent and output_container_and_codec to mov_proresks.

code_snippets.label: typescript

metadata.Background Colors: Transparent, Black, White, Gray, Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Magenta, Orange

video.description: Public URL of the input video: MP4, MOV, WEBM, AVI, or GIF, up to 60 seconds and 16000x16000.

background_color.description: Color that replaces the removed background; set it explicitly. Transparent needs the mov_proresks preset: with any other preset Bria uses Black and returns a `warning`.

output_container_and_codec.description: Output container and codec. Default mp4_h264. mov_proresks (ProRes) is the preset that keeps transparency.

auto_zoom.description: Crop once to the subject for the whole video. Output resolution and aspect ratio may change, and processing is slower. Default false.

preserve_audio.description: Keep the input audio track. Default true.

spill_suppression.description: Strength of green-fringe removal for green-screen footage, from 0 (off) to 1. Default 0.

warning.description: Present when Bria adjusted the request, such as a Transparent background with a preset that has no alpha channel.
